newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds via overnight, 3-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds via overnight, 3-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York added temporary reserves to the banking system on Monday through overnight and three-day fixed system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokesman said.
The reserve injection was in line with expectations. The Fed move, however, took place about an hour earlier than its usual intervention time of 1130 EST/1630 GMT.

Analysts said the reserve adding was moved up due to strong upward pressure on the federal funds rate. At the time of the intervention, funds were traded at 5-3/4 percent, well above the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target.
Pundits said the Fed is also expected to add permanent reserves to the banking system through a coupon pass. The move, they added, could take place as early as Monday.
